description: Migrate packages/auth/src/password.ts from bcryptjs to @node-rs/argon2 (AGENTS.md §4.4 compliance). One-shot migration path for existing bcrypt hashes (verify with bcrypt, re-hash on next successful login). Update 3 science-advantage seed scripts to import hashPassword from @reading-advantage/auth. Remove bcryptjs from apps/science-advantage/package.json production deps. Delete apps/science-advantage/lib/auth/{session,server}.ts (F-401) and re-point all 22 callers to @reading-advantage/auth. Resolves F-401, F-402, F-406.
deviation_notes: Additional tasks for cross-algorithm verify wrapper (bcrypt not natively supported by @node-rs/argon2), isolatedModules const enum fix, and test mock updates for shared auth delegation.
